title: mentha × verticillata f. fallax
intro: Mentha × verticillata f. fallax, commonly known as Corsican mint, is a cultivar of the Mentha × verticillata species, known for its distinct characteristics and uses. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including relief from digestive issues, nausea, and headaches, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory, carminative, and antispasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of Corsican mint include menthone, limonene, and menthol, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant's essential oil has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its extracts have been studied for their potential antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
